map.输入11项尿干化学检测结果，自动判读临床意义: Enter 11-item urine dipstick results for automatic clinical-meaning interpretation.
map.对尿常规干化学与镜检条目做结构化解释与组合提示，辅助报告初读；仅供复核，不替代诊: Structured explanation and combination hints for urine dipstick and microscopy items aid first reading; for review only, not a diagnosis substitute.
map.尿干化学11项：比重(SG)、酸碱度(pH)、白细胞酯酶(LEU)、亚硝酸盐(N: The 11 dipstick items: specific gravity (SG), pH, leukocyte esterase (LEU), nitrite (NIT), protein (PRO), glucose (GLU), ketones (KET), urobilinogen (UBG), bilirubin (BIL), occult blood (ERY/BLD) and vitamin C (VC). Positive results need microscopy and clinical synthesis.
map.体检尿常规异常项（如蛋白+、潜血+）组合理解可能方向。: At checkup, combine abnormal dipstick items (e.g. protein+, occult blood+) to understand possible directions.
map.尿路感染提示（白细胞酯酶+亚硝酸盐）初筛。: Screen for UTI via leukocyte esterase + nitrite.
map.教学演示条目间关联（如酮体+糖提示糖尿病酮症可能）。: Teach inter-item associations (e.g. ketones + glucose suggesting diabetic ketosis).
map.亚硝酸盐+ 且白细胞酯酶+，工具提示尿路感染可能，建议尿培养；若仅潜血+需结合镜: Nitrite+ and leukocyte esterase+: the tool suggests possible UTI and advises urine culture; if only occult blood+, correlate with microscopic RBC.
map.不一定，肌红/血红蛋白也可假阳性；需镜检看红细胞确认。: Not necessarily; myoglobin/hemoglobin can also give false positives; confirm by microscopy RBC.
map.一过性可由运动/发热引起，持续需查肾；定量以 24h 或尿蛋白肌酐比为准。: Transient can come from exercise/fever; persistent needs renal workup; quantification uses 24h or protein-creatinine ratio.
map.不能，干化学仅筛查，确诊靠镜检、培养与临床。: No, dipstick only screens; confirmation needs microscopy, culture and clinical data.
map.尿常规条目解释工具。结构化解读干化学与镜检并组合提示，辅助报告初读；仅供复核。: A urine-dipstick item interpreter. Structurally explains dipstick and microscopy with combination hints, aiding first reading; for review only.
map.逐项判读：尿比重 SG 参考 1.003–1.030（以实验室区间为准；低→水负: Item-by-item interpretation: specific gravity (SG) reference 1.003–1.030 (use the laboratory interval; low → water load/diabetes insipidus, high → dehydration/diabetes); pH reference 4.6–8.0 (use the laboratory interval; acid → acidosis/high-protein diet, alkaline → infection/vegetarian diet). Combination hints: positive leukocyte esterase/nitrite → UTI; positive protein → proteinuria; positive glucose → glycosuria; positive ketones → ketosis; positive blood → hematuria (correlate with microscopy); positive bilirubin → jaundice; increased urobilinogen → hemolytic/hepatocellular jaundice; positive vitamin C → may cause false negatives in several pads. Interpretation is an adjunct and requires clinical review.
